rewards: Ability to create the Salve Amulet

st.t: Talk to the Zealot outside the Abandoned Mine in south west Morytania.
s: And what sort of purpose would that be?
Is there any other way into the mines?
I come seeking challenges and quests.
I follow the path of Saradomin.

st.t: Pickpocket the Zealot outside the Abandoned Mine in south west Morytania.
Go around to the west side of the mountain, at the back of the mine, and enter the southern cart tunnel.
Climb down the ladder to the east.
Climb down another ladder to the east.
Go down the ladder to the south, making sure to avoid the moving mine cart.
Pick a glowing fungus.
Put the glowing fungus into the mine cart north west of the ladder.

Pull levers until the tracks are lined up to take the cart to the north west corner. Open the Points Settings panel, on the wall north-west of the mine cart, and compare its map with the Solution picture: the map shows north pointing to the right, so the cart must end at the ladder in the top right. Your starting layout differs from other players', so pull only the levers whose junctions don't match. Levers A to E are south-east of the panel, and I, J and K are north, around the corner. F, G and H can't be reached. Skeletal miners may attack at both spots. Check the panel again before starting: if the cart sinks, the fungus is lost and you need to put another one in the cart.
Levers A to E stand south-east of the panel. The Solution button shows which lever has which letter.
Levers I, J and K stand north of the panel, around the corner. The Solution button shows which lever has which letter.
Check the Points Settings panel in the centre of the room. Tap the 'Start' button in the interface.

Go back the way you came. Climb the ladder by the fungus pool, go north past the moving cart, take the first path east and climb the ladder. Go west and climb the next ladder, then go west and leave through the cart tunnel.
Make sure you're prepared to fight Treus Dayth (level 95), then go around the back of the mine and enter the north cart tunnel.
Climb down the first ladder, just east of where you come in.
Climb down the north east ladder.
Go down the north west ladder to collect the glowing fungus.
Search the mine cart for the glowing fungus.
Take the fungus back upstairs.
Head all the way east, past the ladder going up, then south past the moving cart. Climb down the ladder there.
Pick up the chisel nearby.
Use the Zealot's key on the water valve. Make sure you have some energy as you'll need to race to the lift afterwards.
Race to the lift before the ghost turns off the valve.
Go down the east stairs.
Attempt to pick up the innocent-looking key. Treus Dayth (level 95) will spawn. Kill him.
Pick up the innocent-looking key.
Go back up to the flooded area.
Go down the west stairs.
Cut from a crystal outcrop with a chisel in the south room to finish the quest.
